decisions.reason: Testing the layout on Heyzine does not select a new hosting platform or change the existing free-hosting and candidate-platform requirements.
Advertisement blurriness is an independent observation already represented from the same message; the two-page flipbook display rule does not change advertisement rendering requirements.
The body-font feedback is independent of the requirement for balanced two-page flipbook spreads and is already represented from the same message.
Article-ending whitespace balance is a separate page-content concern; the use of the word balance does not make it dependent on flipbook spread display.
The table-of-contents pagination correction is independently stated and already represented; balanced flipbook spreads do not alter its current accuracy requirements.
The source does not establish a new launch date or otherwise modify the existing launch deadline.
Two-page flipbook display behavior does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
Testing balanced two-page spreads does not necessarily change article order, flat-plan usage, or existing placement rules; no specific pagination-state update is entailed.
The flipbook spread-display requirement does not change author names, photographs, sizing, shape, coverage, or source.
Balanced two-page flipbook display does not modify the established visual style, branding reference, or color-use constraints.
Article text and visual pacing remains valid unchanged; spread-display balance does not entail a change to image requests, blurbs, or quotes.
The two-page spread-display requirement neither adds nor removes any required article or tribute-page content.
